{{Top|leg}}
'''Molecular-magnetic clamps''' were located on the bottom of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. They were used to mount additional equipment to the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], such as extra [[Fuel slug/Legends|fuel slugs]] for long range flight or a heavy-duty [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] for military use.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
